units.source_text: 此信古色古香，字迹则甚颤抖。

en.t: This letter had an antique air, and the handwriting was very shaky.

units.source_text: 送到之时，正值源氏太政大臣来此指示仪式中种种事宜。

en.t: When it was delivered, Genji, the Grand Minister, happened to be there giving instructions on the various details of the ceremony.

units.source_text: 他就看信，看毕说道：“这真是古风的书简，可惜字写得太吃力了。

en.t: He read the letter at once, and when he had finished, he said, “This is truly an old-fashioned letter, though it is a pity the characters look so laboriously written.

units.source_text: 她早年擅长书法，年纪一大，笔力就异常衰弱，颤抖得厉害呢。”

en.t: In her younger days she was skilled at calligraphy, but with age her brush strength has grown terribly weak, and her hand trembles badly.”

units.source_text: 他反复看了几遍，又说：“这首诗和玉梳盒贴切之极！

en.t: He read it over several times, then said again, “This poem suits the jeweled comb box perfectly!

units.source_text: 三十一个字母之中，和玉梳盒无关的很少。

en.t: Among its thirty-one syllables, hardly any are unrelated to the jeweled comb box.
That is no easy thing at all!”
After saying this, he began to chuckle.
